title: Agility 57–99 · Hardcore Worlds edition
subtitle: Zerker build with quest-only Defence · informed danger: every risk shown, every risk prepared for
intro: Hardcore Worlds: almost every death ends the run, including many that are safe for a Hardcore Ironman. Each step lists what can kill you and how to prepare.
Danger badge: the big number is the score without prep; 'with prep' is what the prep card buys. The Fractured Archive = one hundred, the top of the scale.
Route hours exclude all quest time; no verified source gives quest durations.
Balanced is not faster than Safest. Choose it for its quests (lyre to Rellekka, Tirannwn, quest Defence), not for speed.
Standing rules: Defence only from quests; Ranged on Rapid or Accurate; dismiss every random event; no AFK, player-owned house, Nightmare Zone, Rogues' Den maze, poison chalice or Wilderness.
Profit is at the Hardcore Worlds GE mid price, assuming every mark is sold, before any GE tax; the Graceful outfit ({{fact:F-4004}} marks) is not deducted.

steps.summary: New quest (under a month old) with a teleport-blocked prison cell. Gives {{step.xp_gained}} fixed Agility XP, no required kills and no Defence XP.
instructions: Read the current wiki walkthrough end to end. If it lists any fight, aggressive monster or damage source not on this card, stop and ask for a re-rating.
Bank: mid-heal food from the card and one teleport usable outside the prison cell.
Gear: normal non-Defence setup; the quest needs no combat.
Travel: start with Betty at Land's End, at full HP.
Do: follow the quest. The ambush is a scripted knock-out cutscene, not a fight.
Do: in the Port Piscarilius prison cell, do not teleport. Remove the plank, climb through the north-wall gap and walk clear of the guards first.
Stop: when the quest completes. The Thieving reward moves you toward Death on the Isle's requirement.
warnings: Mandatory: re-read the walkthrough on the day you start. This is new content and its two dungeons were not reviewed. Anything new on the page means stop and get a re-rating.
Mandatory: start at full HP with the card's food and a teleport. Never enter the prison area below {{risk.min_hitpoints}} HP.
The prison cell blocks teleports. A guard who catches you sends you back in; the plank and north-wall gap are the only way out.
Stop condition: if you lose HP in a dungeon and cannot see why, leave at once (exact line in 'Stop immediately if').
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
Any death here is official and run-ending; no Hardcore Worlds safe exception covers this quest.
tips: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). Held up by the new-content floor, not by known damage.

steps.summary: Short Kourend quest for {{step.xp_gained}} fixed Agility XP. The only kill is a weak Sand Snake you can safespot.
instructions: Bank: bow and arrows for the safespot, the few mid-heal food on the card, and a teleport.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Travel: Great Kourend. The Crabclaw Caves section is an instance.
Do: be at full HP before every stepping stone and rock; eat back to full after any fall.
Do: fight the Sand Snake only from the west-wall safespot. Go north or south along the west wall, then hug it back to the centre entrance.
Stop: when the quest completes. To leave the caves early, walk out and teleport once outside the instance.
warnings: Mandatory: fight the snake only from the west-wall safespot with Ranged. Stop condition: if the safespot fails and the snake reaches you, leave the cave.
Mandatory: full HP with food before the stepping stones and rocks; their fall damage is unpublished.
Stop condition: stop and eat if HP falls to the card's eat line.
Do not rely on a teleport inside the cave; whether it works there is not stated. Walk out first.
tips: Prerequisites are already done; fixed XP is worth the most where training is slowest.

steps.summary: {{step.xp_gained}} fixed Agility XP and the key to A Tail of Two Cats' lamps. Danger: teleport-blocked flashback fights; the right protection prayer makes them safe.
instructions: Bank: the card's food, full waterskins, an antipoison, prayer restores, your cat or kitten, and Ranged gear.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Travel: magic carpet across the desert with full waterskins. Never walk the River Elid banks or north of Sophanem.
Do: examine the canopic jar before the pit jump; it sets which guardian you face.
Do: start each fight with full prayer and hold it to the end: Protect from Magic for the Possessed Priest and Apmeken, Protect from Melee for Het or Scabaras.
Do: in Klenter's Pyramid, cure scarab poison at once with antipoison.
Stop: when the quest completes, then go on to A Tail of Two Cats.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). No teleport works during a flashback. A disconnect with no prayer up is what kills; the correct protection prayer fully protects.
Mandatory: enter each flashback at full HP and full prayer with food. If prayer or HP falls to the card's lines, walk back toward the entrance, or log out once unhit long enough.
Stop conditions: do not start a flashback with prayer under the card's line; leave if HP falls to the card's line; never start the pit jump before examining the jar.
Mandatory: desert travel by carpet with waterskins only. The River Elid and the area north of Sophanem mean heat and aggressive crocodiles.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
A death here is official on Hardcore Worlds and also loses your cat.
tips: Worth it for the Agility XP and the gate to A Tail of Two Cats and its two lamps.
Safer choice: decision point `DP02` option A skips this block.

steps.summary: No required kills. Rub both lamps into Agility for {{step.xp_gained}} XP.
instructions: Bank: death runes, a chocolate cake (buy it), your cat or kitten, a few food and full waterskins (counts on the card).
Gear: light travel gear; no fight is required.
Travel: magic carpet across the desert. Never walk the river banks or north of Sophanem.
Do: follow the quest; the dragon scenes are cutscenes.
Do: rub both lamps and choose Agility, never Defence.
Stop: when both lamps are spent and the quest is complete.
warnings: Mandatory: both lamps go into Agility (or another non-Defence skill). Never click Defence.
Mandatory: carpet-only desert travel with full waterskins. Stop condition: leave the desert if your waterskins run out.
Stop condition: if the quest asks for a fight not described here, stop and ask for a re-rating.

steps.summary: {{step.xp_gained}} fixed Agility XP and the only door to Regicide. Dangers: failed bridge jumps, spiders after Kalrag, Iban's temple spikes. Required fights can be safespotted.
instructions: Bank: a large stack of food (minimum on the card; no bank beyond the Pass), prayer restores, an instant teleport, a bow with non-poisoned metal-tipped arrows, and Ranged ammunition.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Travel: West Ardougne to the Pass entrance. The quest is an instance; any instant teleport exits.
Do: be at {{risk.min_hitpoints}} HP or more before every Iban's Lair bridge jump, the rope swing and the Kalrag fight. Eat at the card's eat line.
Do: safespot the demons from the narrow pathways and the paladins by attacking and running west, with Ranged. Keep Protect from Melee on for Kalrag.
Do: use the plank on wall traps and never stand in front of an armed trap. After Kalrag dies you are briefly stunned; leave the spider corridor at once.
Do: enter Iban's temple at full HP and run in without stopping. After a spike stun, step back, eat to full, then retry.
Stop: when the quest completes, or teleport out when a stop condition below is met.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). Worth it as the gate to Regicide, the largest Agility reward available today, and later the elf chain toward Prifddinas.
Mandatory: never jump a bridge or take the rope swing below {{risk.min_hitpoints}} HP. A failed jump hits hard and lands you among aggressive Soulless.
Mandatory: Iban HP gate. Protect from Melee does nothing against the temple spikes. Enter only at full HP and never retry hurt; after any spike stun, eat to full first.
Stop condition: if the spikes stun you back to the entrance twice in a row, or food is below the card's temple reserve, teleport out and restock.
Stop conditions: teleport out if HP is at the card's line with no food, or more than three monsters attack at once. If stunned among spiders, eat first, then teleport.
Never stand in front of an armed wall trap; it can hit repeatedly and fast enough to kill.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
tips: Read the current card before you go; the earlier owner acceptance of this card is on record.

steps.summary: The largest Agility reward available, {{step.xp_gained}} fixed XP, and the key to Tirannwn. Dangers: the Tyras guard ambush and a second Underground Pass trip.
instructions: Bank: the card's food, an antipoison, prayer restores, an instant teleport, and Ranged weapon and ammunition.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Travel: back through the Underground Pass under the same rules: bridges and the rope swing only at the card's HP line or above.
Do: turn Protect from Melee on before the dense forest. Keep it on until you reach the mushroom safespot or the guard is dead, then finish him with Ranged.
Do: step around Isafdar trap tiles; cure tripwire poison at once.
Do: once you hold the Big Book of Bangs, coal tar and sulphur, leave Isafdar by teleport.
Stop: when the quest completes.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). A disconnect as the Tyras guard engages is the killer; Protect from Melee, documented to stop this guard, removes it.
Mandatory: never climb through the dense forest with prayer under the card's line.
Mandatory: never jump a Pass bridge below the card's HP line. Stop condition: teleport out if HP is at the card's line and food is gone.
Bail-out: if the guard is hitting you, keep Protect from Melee on and walk to the mushroom safespot; if prayer runs low, teleport immediately.
Escape crystal: optional and not credited. Its behaviour in open-world Isafdar is undocumented and it never fires while you move. Never lower another precaution for it.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
tips: Tirannwn is the first link of the Song of the Elves chain toward Prifddinas.
Safer choice: decision point `DP02` option A, at the cost of this reward and the Tirannwn gate.

steps.summary: Alternative before Seers' (decision point `DP01`, option B): the best marks of grace of the low courses ({{fact:F-4024}}), at about half Falador's XP rate.
instructions: Bank: Canifis bank, beside the course start; take the card's food.
Gear: light clothing; no combat gear.
Travel: the Ectophial is a free teleport nearby if you need to leave.
Do: run laps. The only failable obstacle is the third gap, which stops failing at {{fact:F-4073}}.
Do: eat whenever HP is {{risk.min_hitpoints}} or lower.
Stop: at {{fact:F-1015}} when Seers' opens, or at any stop condition below.
warnings: Fail damage is unpublished; this rule is conservative, not sourced. Eat at {{risk.min_hitpoints}} HP or lower, stop below the card's stop line, re-rate after any fail above the card's limit.
Never use the Attack option on a Canifis citizen; a misclick turns them into high-level werewolves. Stay out of the ghoul grounds north of town.
Dismiss every random event and never go AFK; a death inside a random event is official. Take a break every hour.
tips: Pick Falador instead if speed matters more than an early Graceful start.
Profit: marks of grace sell as amylase crystals on the Hardcore Worlds GE; see the step stats.

steps.summary: Koschei's first three forms are run-ending with no documented exit; only the fourth is a safe death. Gives {{step.xp_gained}} Agility XP, quest Defence, the lyre.
instructions: Bank for the road trips: food, Camelot teleport tablets (at least two per trip), and Ranged weapon and ammunition.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Before the lyre: Camelot tablet, then the road north, left at the first fork. Stay on the road, skip the log balance north of Sinclair Mansion, fight nothing.
Do: farm the lyre from the non-aggressive citizens using the fire safespots with Ranged.
Do: fight the Draugen only during the hunt, at full HP with food.
Before the duel, bank your escape crystal and any ring of life. Take a full inventory of monkfish ({{fact:F-4062}} each) and an antipoison; no weapons, armour or runes.
Before the duel: cure any poison, check your connection is stable, and be at full HP ({{risk.min_hitpoints}}).
Do, first three forms: start each form at full HP, eat at the card's eat line, and trap Koschei across the floor hole or by the fire pillars to eat.
Do, fourth form: do not resist. Let him wear you down until the fight ends; this form is the safe phase.
Stop: when the quest completes. Keep the enchanted lyre charged for Rellekka.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). Highest with-prep score on the Balanced route. The first three forms have no documented exit, and a disconnect in the second or third is likely fatal.
Mandatory: bank the escape crystal before the duel. Worn, it acts like a ring of life and resets the fight to the first form; carried, it can fire if you stand still in the fourth.
Never wear a ring of life in the duel. It sends you to your respawn point and restarts the fight at the first form; it is not an exit.
Mandatory: start every form at full HP ({{risk.min_hitpoints}}), eat at the card's eat line, and trap Koschei whenever you need to eat and regenerate.
Stop condition: in the first three forms, if food falls to the card's reserve line, trap Koschei and stall. He eventually vanishes and the fight restarts: a time cost, not a death.
Mandatory: start the duel only on a stable connection and never below full HP. A disconnect leaves you in combat for up to a minute.
Camelot road before the lyre: travel at full HP with food and tablets. Walk on through chip damage; teleport at once at the card's road line or if two attackers engage.
If the Draugen engages outside the hunt, teleport away. Stop condition: leave Rellekka if HP falls to the card's Draugen line during the fight.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
This card changed since you first accepted it: no ring of life, no exit in the first three forms, and an unresearched road. Read it again before decision point `DP08` option B.
tips: Worth it for Agility XP, quest Defence far under your cap (watch the cap bar), and the lyre teleport that skips the long Camelot road.
Safer alternative: decision point `DP08` option A, staying on Pollnivneach with no Fremennik Trials.

Mandatory: eat at {{risk.min_hitpoints}}; stop if HP falls to the card's stop line.
Dismiss every random event and never go AFK; a death inside a random event is official. Take a break every hour.
tips: The tightrope fall scales with current HP and deals nothing at very low HP; it is the only damage here.
To leave, climb down and use the lyre or a Camelot tablet; bank at Seers' Village.
Profit: about {{step.hours}} of laps; marks sell as amylase crystals on the Hardcore Worlds GE.

steps.summary: {{step.actions}} laps, about {{step.hours}}, from {{step.start_level}} to {{step.end_level}}: the finish of every route and the longest stretch of the guide.
instructions: Bank: East Ardougne; take the card's food and Ardougne teleport tablets.
Gear: Graceful.
Travel: Ardougne tablet to the market. The course starts at the beams by the gem stall.
Do: run laps. Use Rapid Heal, recharge prayer at the East Ardougne church altar, and buy food at the market bakery stall.
Do: eat whenever HP is {{risk.min_hitpoints}} or lower.
Do: collect marks when convenient; they stack on one tile, so stopping loses nothing.
Stop: at {{step.end_level}}. The cape is yours.
warnings: Fail damage is unpublished; this rule is conservative, not sourced. Eat at {{risk.min_hitpoints}} HP or lower, stop below the card's stop line, re-rate after any fail above the card's limit.
Failable obstacles: the first two gaps, which stop failing at {{fact:F-4071}}.
Mandatory: never touch the lever near the West Ardougne gate. It teleports you into deep Wilderness, where PvP is live and a player kill is an official death.
Longest exposure in the guide. Dismiss every random event and never go AFK; take a break every hour.
tips: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}} is the highest on the Safest route from unpublished fail damage over the most hours, not from anything that hits hard.
Profit: about {{step.hours}} of laps; marks sell as amylase crystals on the Hardcore Worlds GE.

steps.summary: No Agility XP ({{fact:F-5301}}). It is only the gate to Troll Stronghold, and is safe only by the secret path.
instructions: Bank: the quest items on the card (coins, bread, trout, an iron bar, an Asgarnian ale), a few food and a games necklace.
Gear: light gear; no fight is required.
Travel: Burthorpe, then Tenzing's house.
Do: use only the secret path from Tenzing's house.
Do: never take the northern path and never step onto the plateau.
Stop: at quest completion; leave by games necklace.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}: the northern path is multi-combat with thrower trolls whose attacks always hit, and a disconnect there is likely fatal. On the secret path with prep it is {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}).
Mandatory: use only the secret path from Tenzing's house.
Mandatory: if any thrower troll engages, turn on Protect from Missiles and leave.
Stop conditions: turn back if you see a warning sign (you are on the normal path); leave if two or more trolls engage.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
Bail-out: Protect from Missiles on, walk back down the secret path, games necklace to Burthorpe.
tips: Only worth doing if you choose decision point `DP03` option B or C.

steps.summary: Aggressive Troll generals can kill from full HP in two hits. Prep brings it to {{risk.tier}}. Reward: {{fact:F-2022}} and the gate to Troll Romance.
instructions: Bank: a full inventory of monkfish ({{fact:F-4062}} each), prayer potions, a games necklace, and Ranged weapon and ammunition.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Travel: Trollheim by the rock shortcuts, which avoid the thrower trolls on the mountain path.
Do: fight Dad only from the western-gate safespot, with Ranged.
Do: turn Protect from Melee on before entering the generals' room, then kill only the southern-most general from the desk safespot with Ranged.
Do: fight Berry and Twig only from inside a vacant cell.
Do: leave by the secret exit to the south and teleport out.
Stop: at quest completion, or at any stop condition below.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). Optional for Agility alone; decision point `DP03` option A skips it. Worth it for the quest and the gate to Troll Romance.
Mandatory: never enter the generals' room without Protect from Melee on, full prayer and full HP ({{risk.min_hitpoints}}).
Mandatory: in the generals' room, eat whenever HP is at or below a general's maximum hit (the card's eat line). Below it, one hit can kill.
Stop conditions: leave if two generals attack; leave the room and teleport if food or prayer falls to the card's lines.
Never fight a general in melee range. Bail-out: keep Protect from Melee on, back away to the desk safespot or out of the room, and teleport.
Escape crystal: optional and not credited; its scope here is undocumented and it does not fire while you move. Never lower another precaution for it.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
tips: If you plan Troll Romance (`DP03` option C), do this first: it tests holding a protection prayer and eating under fire before Arrg.

steps.summary: Arrg attacks on arrival and the run to the safespot cannot be made fully safe. Reward: {{fact:F-2031}} of Agility, saving almost no training time.
instructions: Bank: a full inventory of monkfish ({{fact:F-4062}} each), leaving room for prayer potions; Ranged weapon and ammunition.
Gear: Ranged on Rapid or Accurate, never Longrange; Longrange gives Defence XP.
Travel: Trollheim to the troll arena at full HP and full prayer, on a stable connection.
Do: turn Protect from Melee on before you talk to Arrg.
Do: run straight to the north-west wall or west-gate safespot without fighting. Eat one piece whenever HP reaches the card's run eat line and keep moving.
Do: at the safespot, switch to Protect from Missiles and fight with Ranged. Eat at the card's safespot line and keep prayer topped up.
Stop: when Arrg dies, or hold the safespot until he despawns if a stop condition is met.
warnings: The run window cannot be closed. With Protect from Melee on, two maximum ranged hits and one monkfish leave you almost dead from full HP; a third hit, or melee through the prayer, kills.
No verified food heals more, no combo-eating is verified, and the run's length is undocumented.
Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). Highest with-prep score in this plan. A death here is run-ending and not a safe death even for Hardcore Ironmen.
Stop condition before starting: do not start unless you accept that the run can kill a prepared player, or if Troll Stronghold showed you cannot hold a protection prayer and eat under fire.
Mandatory: talk to Arrg at full HP ({{risk.min_hitpoints}}), full prayer, Protect from Melee already on and a full inventory of monkfish-class food.
Mandatory: start only on a stable connection. A disconnect leaves you in combat for up to a minute, and during the run both his attacks can reach you.
Stop condition: if food or prayer falls to the card's lines at the safespot, stop attacking and hold it under Protect from Missiles until Arrg despawns; restock and return.
No bail-out during the run: keep moving and eat. Teleport in the arena is undocumented (last resort only), logging out is not an exit, and the escape crystal never fires while you move.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
tips: Reason to do it: Strength XP and quest completion. Optional for Agility; decision point `DP03` option A skips it.

steps.summary: No Agility XP. Unlocks Herblore and leads to Recruitment Drive (decision point `DP04`, option B).
instructions: Bank: the raw meats for the cauldron, the card's food and a teleport.
Gear: light gear; you are running, not fighting.
Travel: Taverley, then Taverley Dungeon, at full HP.
Do: run past the skeletons and the suits of armour without fighting.
Stop: at quest completion; teleport out of the dungeon.
warnings: Mandatory: enter Taverley Dungeon at full HP with food, run past the skeletons and suits, and teleport out if HP falls to the card's line.
Stop condition: stop if more than two monsters follow you.
The dungeon monsters' max hits were not researched, so the score is conservative.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.

steps.summary: No Agility XP. Recruitment Drive prerequisite with two combat lamps; never choose Defence on either.
instructions: Bank: the quest disguise items, the card's food and a teleport.
Gear: the disguise; no fight is required.
Travel: the Black Knights' Fortress, north of Falador.
Do: evade the Black Knights; do not fight them.
Do: rub both lamps into Attack, Strength, Ranged, Magic, Hitpoints or Prayer.
Stop: at quest completion.
warnings: NEVER click Defence on either lamp. It is offered as a valid choice, and on your zerker build it is a trap.
Mandatory: evade the knights at full HP with food; leave and teleport if more than one engages or HP falls to the card's line.
The knights' max hit was not researched, so the score is conservative.

steps.summary: Agility reward of {{fact:F-2009}} after two prerequisite quests. The fight is against Sir Leye, with no armour or food allowed.
instructions: Bank: nothing to bring; the tests allow no armour, food or potions.
Travel: the Temple Knight testing grounds in Falador.
Do: work through the tests; fight Sir Leye at full HP ({{risk.min_hitpoints}}).
Stop: at quest completion, or by the yellow portal at any stop condition below.
warnings: Mandatory: leave by the yellow portal at the room start if HP falls to the card's line or Sir Leye heals faster than you damage him.
This fight is not a safe death even for Hardcore Ironmen; on Hardcore Worlds it is official.
tips: Three quests for a small Agility reward: only worth it if you clear quests for their own sake.

steps.summary: Agility reward of {{fact:F-2501}}, blocked by its Thieving requirement. Its fights are scripted to stop before death.
instructions: First: train Thieving to the requirement on this step. That training has not been danger-rated; ask for a rating before picking a method.
Bank: nothing can be carried into the villa; the Head Butler holds your items.
Travel: Varlamore, Villa Lucens.
Do: enter the villa at full HP ({{risk.min_hitpoints}}) and fight the two scripted fights.
Stop: if a fight goes wrong, stop attacking and let the scripted fight end; walk out and reclaim your items from the Head Butler.
warnings: Mandatory: enter the villa at full HP. You go in with no food, equipment, escape crystal or teleports.
Stop condition: if Naiatli deals real damage beyond chip, stop and ask for a re-rating.
No Hardcore Worlds safe exception covers this quest. The wiki says the fights cannot kill, but any death would be official.
tips: Never drink a poison chalice for a Thieving boost; it can deal more damage than your whole HP.

steps.summary: Long-term goal: locked behind Sins of the Father and a Hitpoints level well above yours. Trap damage is undocumented; a death is official.
instructions: Before starting: complete Sins of the Father (its veto lifts after its fights are researched and its prep card is written) and train Hitpoints to the wiki's recommendation ({{fact:F-3056}}).
Bank: food until you own the hallowed ring, antipoison, stamina potions and a Saradomin item.
Gear: the hallowed ring as soon as you can afford it, and a Saradomin item so obelisks restore run energy.
Travel: a hallowed crystal shard straight to the lobby, or vyre noble robes for Darkmeyer.
Do: practise the first three floors before the fourth ({{fact:F-0018}}).
Do: after a trap hit, stop on a tile clear of traps, eat to full, then move on.
Stop: at the card's floor HP line. The exit plan is stop, eat, then move; never teleport.
warnings: Headline {{risk.inherent_ds}}, with prep {{risk.residual_ds}} ({{risk.tier}}). Rated at your current Hitpoints and re-rated when it becomes reachable.
Mandatory: do not enter below {{risk.min_hitpoints}} Hitpoints, the wiki's recommendation and the only verified trap-damage guidance. Train Hitpoints first.
Mandatory: buy the hallowed ring first and wear it every run. It negates trap damage, not portal-frame or grapple failures.
Mandatory: never cross Darkmeyer without vyre noble robes unless you arrive by crystal shard; the Vyrewatch Sentinels are aggressive.
Mandatory: carry antipoison for failed coffin loot, plus stamina potions and a Saradomin item so you never stand still mid-floor without run energy.
Stop conditions: stop if HP falls to the card's line and eat to full on a clear tile; stop and ask for a re-rating if one trap hit exceeds the card's limit.
Defence cap: the Sins of the Father chain forces some Defence XP; with The Fremennik Trials it stays under your cap. Put no lamp or tome from the chain into Defence.
The escape crystal's behaviour inside the Sepulchre is undocumented; never plan around it.
Stop condition: dismiss every random event. A death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds.
tips: No marks of grace here ({{fact:F-1061}}); get Graceful on the rooftops first.
Profit: no marks drop here; see the step stats for what the course earns.

steps.summary: Stay-on-Seers' option (decision point `DP06`, option B): bank at the start, but slower than Pollnivneach and failing until {{fact:F-1018}}.
instructions: Bank: Seers' Village bank at the start; take the card's food (less once fails stop).
Gear: Graceful or light clothing.
Travel: walk from the bank; Camelot tablets land at Camelot.
Do: run laps with Rapid Heal on; recharge at the church altar; buy food at the Forester's Arms.
Do: eat whenever HP is {{risk.min_hitpoints}} or lower.
Stop: at {{fact:F-1033}}, when Rellekka opens.
warnings: Fail damage is unpublished; this rule is conservative, not sourced. Eat at {{risk.min_hitpoints}} HP or lower, stop below the card's stop line, re-rate after any fail above the card's limit.
Failable obstacles: the first gap and the tightrope.
Dismiss every random event and never go AFK; a death inside a random event is official. Take a break every hour.
tips: Pollnivneach (recommended) is faster and its fail damage is small and known.
Profit: marks of grace sell as amylase crystals on the Hardcore Worlds GE; see the step stats.

outro: Werewolf Agility Course is blocked: the deathslide's maximum fall damage is unpublished. It lifts when Agility and Strength pass the never-fail point, or a source publishes the maximum.
Sins of the Father and the Hallowed Sepulchre are blocked: the quest's fights were never researched. It lifts after a research request and a Risk Officer re-rating at your stats.
The Graveyard and its new course are announced but not released, so they are not in this guide. Never choose Defence on its lamps.
Prayer up before the fight, not during it. When the card says stop, stop.
